title: Cross-Industry Hot Work Permit Record — Shared Base
description: Shared base evidence model for hot work permit records across industries. Derived from psm-hot-work-permit-record.json (the most complete domain-specific hot work permit model) with common core fields from railway thermite-welding hot-work, shipbuilding pre-hot-work gas-free, and ehsconst permit-to-work (hot_work type) provisions. Domain-specific provisions go in industry_specific_fields. Dedicated domain models (e.g., psm-hot-work-permit-record.json, railway-thermite-welding-hot-work-record.json, shipbuilding-pre-hot-work-gas-free-record.json) are preserved per the non-migration decision and remain authoritative for their respective domains.

industry_profile.description: Industry profile determines the legal_basis template and industry_specific_fields schema

issue_date.description: Date the hot work permit was issued.

permit_number.description: Unique permit number assigned to this hot work authorization.

work_location.description: Specific location where the hot work will be performed (e.g., compartment, weld location, unit area).

work_description.description: Description of the hot work activity to be performed (e.g., welding, cutting, grinding, thermite welding).

work_type.description: Classified hot work type. Use industry_specific_fields when the domain taxonomy needs finer granularity.

gas_test.description: Pre-work gas-free verification. Per the domain precedents (railway pre_ignition_lel_percent, shipbuilding lel_percent), any positive LEL reading invalidates the hot work permit; the gas-free certificate is typically valid for a bounded window (e.g., max 4 hours in the shipbuilding precedent) after which retesting is required.

test_timestamp_iso.description: Date and time the gas test was performed.

lel_percent.description: Measured lower explosive limit (LEL) in percent. Must be 0 — a positive LEL reading invalidates the permit.

instrument_id.description: Name or ID of the gas detection instrument used (psm flammable_gas_test / shipbuilding gas_tester_certification_id).

tested_by.description: Name or certification ID of the person who performed the gas test.

safe_to_proceed.description: Confirmation that gas concentration is below the acceptable threshold and work may proceed (psm precedent).

fire_watch.description: Fire watch assignment. Present with required=true whenever the permit conditions demand a fire watch attendant.

required.description: Whether a fire watch attendant is required for this hot work (psm fire_watch_required / railway fire_watch_posted / ehsconst fire_watch_assigned control).

attendant_id.description: Name or ID of the assigned fire watch attendant (required when required is true; psm fire_watch_name).

posted_confirmed.description: Confirms the fire watch is posted at the work location before work starts (railway fire_watch_posted precedent).

authorization.description: Permit authorization. The issuing authority approves the permit before work begins; the performing authority acknowledges execution.

authorized_by.description: Name or ID of the supervisor/authority who authorized the hot work permit (psm authorized_by).

issuing_authority_id.description: ID of the issuing authority (ehsconst issuing_authority_id precedent).

performing_authority_id.description: ID of the performing authority executing the work (ehsconst performing_authority_id precedent).

permit_expiry.description: Date and time at which the permit expires and work must stop unless renewed (psm permit_expiry / ehsconst validity_end / railway possession_window precedent).

closure.description: Permit closure record upon work completion, including post-work fire watch confirmation where applicable.

closed_by.description: Signature or name of the person who closed the permit upon work completion (psm closure_signature / ehsconst closeout_signed).

closure_timestamp.description: Date and time the permit was closed.

closeout_signed.description: Confirms the close-out signature block is complete (ehsconst closeout_signed precedent).

tbm_ref.description: Reference to the Tool Box Meeting (TBM) record covering this hot work, where the crew reviewed the permit conditions. May reference an _shared/tbm-record.json or domain-specific TBM record. Null if not applicable.

risk_assessment_ref.description: Reference to the risk assessment record identifying the fire/explosion hazards for this work. Null if not applicable.

ptw_ref.description: Reference to the parent permit-to-work record when this hot work permit is issued under a general PTW (e.g., ehsconst-ptw-record.json work_type=hot_work). Null when standalone.

industry_specific_fields.description: Domain-specific extension fields (e.g., {thermite_charge_grams, cooling_time_minutes, weld_location_kp} for railway, {compartment_id, oxygen_percent, benzene_ppm, h2s_ppm, co_ppm} for shipbuilding, {contractor_tier, sapa_article_5_compliance} for construction, {flammable_gas_instrument_class} for ehschem/gasterm)

legal_basis.description: Multi-source legal basis. Must cite >= 3 regulatory sources. Common cross-industry base: OSHA-KR Article 38 (safety measures — de facto hot work anchor: safety measures before hazardous work), OSHA-KR Article 36 (risk assessment), SAPA Article 4 (obligation to secure safety and health). Industry-specific additions per the domain's legal_basis template: HPGSCA Article 11 (gas cutting/welding facility safety maintenance — shipbuilding/gasterm), Firearms-Swords-Explosives-Safety Act Article 37 (prohibition of fire handling and smoking — defense/explosives), DSSMA Article 5 (handling of dangerous substances — shipbuilding painting), OSHA-KR Article 44 (process safety management — PSM facilities).
examples: SAPA Article 4 (obligation to secure safety and health)
OSHA-KR Article 38 (safety measures for hot work)
High-Pressure Gas Safety Control Act Article 11 (gas cutting/welding facility safety maintenance plan)
